scientific_integrity: The leading term follows from an exact arithmetic criterion, a convergent Euler-product factorization and the standard Perron/Hankel Selberg--Delange method. Finite exact tests are identified separately as checks; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unconditional asymptotic only for 3 dividing the reduced denominator of the reciprocal-gcd sum. No asymptotics for other denominator primes or complete integrality; no claim of an error term or a rigorously certified truncated decimal constant. Novelty search cannot exclude unpublished or unindexed results. Independent audit not performed.
title: A sharp one-third logarithmic law for the ternary denominator of the reciprocal-gcd sum
